source_semantics.released_checkpoint_loader_current_behav: CheckpointWeightLoader.load calls restore_params(..., restore_type=np.ndarray) and relies on training code to convert/shard later.
source_semantics.restore_params_native_capability: restore_params accepts restore_type=jax.Array and optional sharding; with jax.Array and no explicit sharding it creates one-device replicated NamedSharding on the visible JAX device(s).
source_semantics.train_state_loader_contract: _load_weights_and_validate accepts any loader implementing load(params), then checks PyTree structure, shapes, and dtypes; it does not require numpy arrays.
source_semantics.train_state_initialization: init_train_state passes the loaded partial params to a JIT with replicated_sharding and donate_argnums=(1), so an already-device-resident one-GPU replicated checkpoint is compatible with the same merge/init path.

resource_only_adapter.change: replace released checkpoint host numpy staging with restore_params(..., restore_type=jax.Array) for the already content-addressed local pi05_base params

qualification_goal: Measure whether the same step-0 train state can be constructed while avoiding the large host numpy checkpoint staging that contributed to 69 host-memory/cgroup instability.
